newsitem.title: CHINA: China private sector retail sales up 43 pct in H1.
newsitem.headline: China private sector retail sales up 43 pct in H1.

text.p: Retail sales of consumer goods by China's private sector rose a year-on-year 43 percent in the first half, far surpassing sales by struggling state firms, the China Business Daily said on Wednesday.

The state sector's retail sales of consumer goods inched up just 4.1 percent in the first six months, with their market share slipping to 25.1 percent from 28.7 percent in the same period last year, the newspaper said.
Sales by foreign-invested companies shot up a year-on-year 25.9 percent in the first half, it said.
Total consumer retail sales rose to 1.301 trillion yuan ($156.7 billion) in the period, an increase of 12.1 percent after adjusting for inflation, the newspaper said but gave no further details.
